fusions.name: Hidden Incision
fusions.desc: Slips a conjured blade into the target that deals 18 damage, uses up every affliction you have on it for 60% more damage per affliction, and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Palmed Fan
fusions.desc: Throws a fan of 3 conjured knives, each dealing 8 damage with a 50% chance of [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Whetted Intent
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 35% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Find the Seam
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
